name: researchpilotsystem-core
description: Rebuild specification for the ResearchPilotSystem experiment. States what the system must do and why; architecture is deliberately unconstrained. DESIGN.md is the entry point.

basis.method: source read of the previous implementation plus a live end-to-end API run
basis.liveRun: 2026-09-07T03:15-03:17Z, 24 question calls + 2 narrative calls + 5 malformed-request probes

designDecisions.decision: Conditions are visual and odor. The standard (event-structure) arm is retired.
designDecisions.why: Zero weight in the primary comparison; defined purely by exclusion; produced 6/6 of all observed validation rejections and fell back on 2 of 6 turns while visual and odor had zero rejections across 18 turns.

designDecisions.decision: Prompt proposes, deterministic validator disposes, guaranteed fallback keeps session length fixed at 6 turns.
designDecisions.why: A study whose manipulation silently leaks produces nothing; a condition-dependent dropout is worse than a non-uniform stimulus.

designDecisions.decision: Rejected candidates and fallback reasons are persisted with the result and carried into analysis.
designDecisions.why: Rejection and fallback rate per condition measures whether a condition can be sustained; the standard arm failed silently until generation records were examined.

designDecisions.decision: Draw candidates in parallel and use the validator to select; add a repair pass before falling back.
designDecisions.why: Sequential retry with flag-name feedback recovered 0 of 6 observed failures.

designDecisions.decision: The six-value turnFunction field is removed.
designDecisions.why: Never enforced against the turn number, never read, and only 3 of its 6 values were ever emitted across 24 live turns.

designDecisions.decision: MC-EVENT is a dilution diagnostic, not a manipulation check.
designDecisions.why: With standard retired, event-structure content enters only via neutral transitions; MC-EVENT now measures that leakage.

designDecisions.decision: The synthetic harness is re-run on every prompt-design change, in parallel with human piloting. It is explicitly not a gate: no pre-registered threshold blocks an arm.
designDecisions.why: Re-evaluation is standing practice, so per-change approval tasks add nothing, and passing a machine check is not a precondition for human piloting. Fallback, rejection and neutral-transition counts are still measured and reported descriptively — not gating is not the same as not measuring.

inherited: two storage modes behind one save interface
unconstrained: storage implementation behind the save interface

modules.purpose: Visual walkthrough of the whole system on one page: the studied chain, the two conditions with real questions, an annotated real session, what the validator rejected and why the third condition was retired, what is recorded and how far it can be trusted, the directory map, and what is fixed vs free

Why the research exists: the question, the two literatures and the limit on borrowing from them, the problem being addressed, purpose and contribution, what is explicitly not claimed, design commitments, pilot status
The specification: what is measured, the two conditions, participant flow, the core mechanism, generation requirements, measurement, inherited storage and operations, what is left free
Turn structure, generator input, decision procedure, neutral transitions, candidate budget and guaranteed completion
Every rule and lexical pattern for questions and narrative sentences, plus the known false positives that must be fixed
The guaranteed-completion ladder and the full JA/EN fixed question sets

The narrative step in full: input and the question-presupposition prohibition, what invention is bounded by, the language-dependent sentence joining rule, sentence-counting and structural rules, why the annotations are untrusted, and why there is no fallback
What flows in and out of each generation step and what must be recorded, transport-independent
All 18 rating items in both languages, anchors, and the two-condition analysis plan
What must be recorded, save-time consistency gates, the consent lock, both storage modes
Synthetic persona batch, its metrics, and when to re-run it (continuously, and not as a gate)
Evidence appendix: the live run of the previous three-condition implementation that the decisions above rest on

Every run on record with the configuration behind it: 2026-07-25 prompt evaluation, v0.4.2/v0.4.3 validations, 2026-09-05 Luna/Astra batch, 2026-09-06 three-scenario live validation, 2026-09-07 live probe. Index in evidence/README.md
The shared recall trigger wording (v0.1.2), JA/EN, with the non-recall and abort handling — a preserved instrument
Manipulation check and diagnostic item specification with the evidence classification; machine form in manipulation-check.yaml. Item roles and contrast were re-cut by (sync pending, TASK-023)
Participant consent text draft v0.2.0: API transmission, retention, withdrawal. Contact and institutional details still blank
Record of the cloud-database connection check on the previous implementation: schema, RLS, idempotent re-submit, export — reference, not a requirement
Design rationale per prompt version, v0.4.1 to v0.4.4: what each version changed and why
The ten synthetic personas (fragment + seven-section ground truth, 3 without odor memory) used by the harness and by the batches on record

Agent working instructions for a project built from this directory: project context, the no-subagent working policy, research and data boundaries, and the verification chain. Copy to the new project root as AGENTS.md.

prompts.warning: Preserved from the three-condition implementation with one edit: the [condition-standard] guidance section was deleted on 2026-09-07. Guidance is spliced one section at a time, so that deletion cannot change a visual or odor prompt. Still outstanding: turnFunction is retired from the contract but is still named in follow-up.ja.txt / follow-up.en.txt, and that text is in the body of every rendered prompt — removing it changes the prompt and has not been measured (TASK-023).
